rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese term for a person, organization, or place’s carbon footprint.

example.english: I take fewer flights now to reduce my carbon footprint.
example.traditional: 我而家少搭飛機，想減低自己嘅碳足跡。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 siu2 daap3 fei1 gei1 soeng2 gaam2 dai1 zi6 gei2 ge3 taan3 zuk1 zik1

rows.note: Use this when you want to stress the measurable amount of carbon dioxide emitted rather than the broader footprint label.

example.english: This factory’s carbon footprint was twenty percent lower last year than the year before.
example.traditional: 呢間工廠上年嘅碳排放量比前年少咗兩成。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 gung1 cong2 soeng6 nin2 ge3 taan3 paai4 fong3 loeng6 bei2 cin4 nin2 siu2 zo2 loeng5 sing4
